newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hagemeyer sees further profit increase.
newsitem.headline: Hagemeyer sees further profit increase.

text.p: Trading company Hagemeyer NV said on Wednesday it expected a further increase in profits in 1997.

"Hagemeyer is well positioned in its markets in 1997. Organic growth, together with the effect of recent acquisitions and repositionings should contribute to a further increase in profits," Hagemeyer said in a statement.
"Overall, the board of management expects a continued improvement in earnings per share in 1997," it added.
Earlier Hagemeyer, in which Hong Kong's First Pacific Co has a controlling stake, reported 1996 net profit of 285.2 million guilders, up from 1995's 193.3 million.
